name: Pythagorean Number Mysticism
note: The Pythagorean doctrine that numbers are the divine archai (first principles) of reality ('all is number'); the tetractys as a sacred figure and the special sanctity of particular numbers, founding the Western tradition of sacred arithmetic. Pythagoras fl. c. 530 BCE.

name: Gematria
note: The Kabbalistic technique in which Hebrew letters equal numerical values, so words sharing a sum share hidden meaning; numbers thereby carry divine and angelic significance. The ten sefirot are themselves the numerical emanations of the divine.

name: The Scale of Numbers (Agrippa)
note: In De occulta philosophia Book II, Agrippa tabulates each number 1-12 against its angels, divine names, planetary and cosmic ranks (the Scales of the numbers). This is the explicit number-to-angel bridge that joins ancient number mysticism to angelology.

name: Modern Numerology
note: The late-19th and 20th-century revival of Pythagorean number meaning (life-path and destiny numbers, the spiritual significance of repeating digits), popularized through Theosophical and New Thought milieus.

name: 999 (Juice WRLD)
note: Rapper Juice WRLD's '999' creed: the inversion of 666, turning pain and negativity into something good and rising above. After his death (Dec 2019) fans use 999 (and the 999 Club) as a devotional, memorial and apotropaic sign. Included because fans genuinely use it as a mantra/protective sign, not as fiction.
The widespread make-a-wish / synchronicity practice of noticing the time 11:11, read as an angelic or 'the Universe' sign of alignment - a digital-age angel-number devotion.
